title: Uncharted: The Nathan Drake Collection
notes: For the Uncharted: The Nathan Drake Collection PC recompilation. Each game still decides when you've earned a trophy; the recomp writes it to its log (last_run.log), and Vault reads that log and never touches the game.
All three games' trophies are here, each with its own platinum. Vault tells the games apart by which game's files the log shows being loaded.
The recomp starts a fresh log every launch, so keep Vault running while you play.

testGuide.title: Find a treasure
testGuide.detail: Pick up the first treasure in any of the three games. "First Treasure" for that game should pop up within a few seconds, and Playing should show which game you're in.
